summary: preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727 KB sibling bundle
details: The package declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases into a temporary directory and then invokes `execFileSync` on the freshly extracted `bun` binary with `math_init.js` as its argument. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle with a shuffled string-array decoder (`WV8StW`), a large hex/string constant pool (`n7gIxM`), and randomized identifier names (`MmgoCP`, `etDiOOB`, `hc1jfK9`,...); the file name has no relationship to any math functionality. The package advertises itself as a React chatbot UI and has no documented need for a second language runtime or an obfuscated install-time bundle. The result on `npm install` is arbitrary code execution under the Bun runtime, structured to bypass Node-oriented inspection by moving the payload out of the Node execution path.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
